_comment: Canonical cross-runtime hydra:v1 test vectors. Reproducible by any runtime (native Rust, wasm, TS) from the pinned algorithm below. All values are integer/ppm; no floating point. Generated by an independent python3 reference: libs/games/scripts/gen_vectors.py. Round seeds are the first server-N whose round satisfies the vector's predicate.

algorithm.seed_derivation: digest(decision, chunk) = blake2b-256 of b'99dot5:engine-seed:v1' (21 bytes, no terminator) || u8 len(game_type) || game_type || u8 len(server_seed) || server_seed || u8 len(client_seed) || client_seed || decision u32 LE || chunk u32 LE. The three text fields are their ASCII bytes as fed to the engine (the 64-hex strings in production) and may not exceed 255 bytes. A decision's randomness is read sequentially from chunk 0, 32 bytes per chunk, at most 4 chunks (128 bytes). preimage_example_hex is the preimage for game_type 'hilo:v1', server_seed '11'*32, client_seed '22'*32, decision 3, chunk 1. hydra:v1: a roll is the next 8 stream bytes as a little-endian u64 raw, reduced to [0, 1e6) by roll = (raw * 1_000_000) >> 64 (Lemire wide multiplication, not modulo)
algorithm.roll_indices: place-bet draws nothing: the player names the gear. The attack made at total_attacks = t (0-based) is decision t and draws its fight roll from stream bytes [0..8] and its damage roll from [8..16] -- both on every attack, death included. Only physical-attack and magic-attack advance total_attacks; drink-potion, drink-mana, cashout, partial-cashout and abandon draw nothing, so they shift no later roll
algorithm.gear: each slot is a tier 0..2 the player picks on the bet (no draw). weapon (atk, matk): common (1,0), rare (2,1), legendary (2,3); armour (def, mdef): cloth (0,1), chain (2,1), plate (4,0); sprite (atk, def, matk, mdef): common (0,0,1,1), rare (1,1,1,1), legendary (2,1,2,2). effective stat = hero base + weapon + armour + sprite
algorithm.heroes: (atk, def, matk, mdef, hp, mp): 0 hercules (5,2,0,1,3,1), 1 knight (2,5,0,3,4,1), 2 magician-boy (0,1,5,2,2,5), 3 magician-girl (1,1,4,4,2,4), 4 amazonian (4,2,2,1,3,2), 5 dev (1,1,1,1,1,1)
algorithm.death_probability: single = clamp(200000 + stage*63636 + bonus[stage][type] - offensive*per_point, 10000, 900000) with per_point 8000 (physical, offensive = atk) or 10000 (magic, offensive = matk); bonus (physical, magic) per stage = (0,0), (20000,-20000), (-20000,20000), (0,0), (-30000,30000), (30000,-30000), (0,0), (-20000,20000), (20000,-20000), (10000,-10000), (30000,-30000), (0,0). death = single folded health-1 more times with half_up(a*b/1e6), then clamped to [1, 999999]. Dies iff fight_roll < death
algorithm.wound: wound_threshold = max(0, single - defensive*8000) with defensive = def (physical) or mdef (magic). A surviving attack wounds iff health > 1 and death <= fight_roll < wound_threshold; a wound costs 1 HP
algorithm.damage: damage roll < 100000 -> 0 (miss), >= 850000 -> 2 (crit), else 1. monster hp per stage = 1,2,1,2,1,2,2,2,3,3,3,4; at 0 the stage advances and the next monster spawns at full hp; clearing stage 11 settles the round as a win
algorithm.step_multiplier: every surviving attack: fair = half_up(1e12 / (1e6 - death)), step = half_up(fair * 995000 / 1e6), so RTP is 99.5% per attack and 0.995^n over n attacks. cum = half_up(cum * step / 1e6); a death sets cum to 0
algorithm.mana_and_potions: magic-attack needs mana > 0 and costs 1 MP whether or not it survives. drink-potion (+1 HP) and drink-mana (+1 MP) are free, admissible only after the first attack and below the hero's max
algorithm.payout: the value model is a (banked, live) pair in integer micro-tez: live starts at stake * 1e6 and each surviving attack folds live' = half_up(live * step / 1e6). The system 'partial-cashout' (borsh payload: amount u128 LE, in the asset's atomic units) moves amount from live to banked without touching the multiplier chain. Cashout (after >= 1 attack), a full clear and the system 'abandon' all pay banked + live (abandon settles abandoned but at the position's current value, sec-28); a death pays banked
algorithm.action_borsh: place-bet payload = borsh(Config { hero: u8, weapon: u8, armour: u8, sprite: u8 }) (4 bytes); every other player action has an empty payload
algorithm.rounding: half-up (midpoint away from zero), mirroring game-engine-core/src/fixed_point.rs

round_vectors.name: abandon-before-first-attack-pays-stake
round_vectors.predicate: abandon with no attack settles abandoned and pays the stake (banked 0 + live = stake)

round_vectors.name: dies-on-attack-3
round_vectors.predicate: hercules attacks physically three times: survives attacks 1 and 2, dies on attack 3, pays 0

round_vectors.name: wounded-then-potion-then-cashout
round_vectors.predicate: knight's first attack survives wounded (HP 4 -> 3), a potion restores HP 4, a second attack survives, cashout

round_vectors.name: magic-costs-mana-then-drink-mana-then-cashout
round_vectors.predicate: magician-boy's magic attack costs 1 MP (5 -> 4), drink-mana restores 5, a second magic attack survives, cashout

round_vectors.name: miss-keeps-stage-then-crit-advances
round_vectors.predicate: hercules clears the lion, misses the 2-HP hydra (damage 0, stage held), then crits it (damage 2, stage 1 -> 2), cashout

round_vectors.name: bank-then-cashout-pays-banked-plus-live
round_vectors.predicate: two surviving attacks, a 50 TEZ partial-cashout, a third surviving attack, cashout pays banked + live

round_vectors.name: bank-then-death-pays-banked
round_vectors.predicate: one surviving attack, a 50 TEZ partial-cashout, then death on attack 2 pays exactly the banked 50 TEZ

round_vectors.name: bank-then-abandon-pays-banked-plus-live
round_vectors.predicate: one surviving attack, a 50 TEZ partial-cashout, a second surviving attack, then abandon settles abandoned paying banked + live

round_vectors.name: wins-all-12-stages
round_vectors.predicate: knight tops up HP/MP after every attack, picks the safer attack type per stage, and wins all 12 stages
